canonical_name: Easterhouse grid connection (potential data centre site)
summary: A 500MW gate 2 grid connection reported by APRS (citing NESO's Existing Agreements Register) for 'Easterhouse' — presumed to be the Easterhouse area of east Glasgow. No planning application, pre-application notice, developer announcement or press coverage has been found; the site exists in the public record only as a grid connection agreement. No developer has been identified.
maturity_explanation: Only evidence is a reported 500MW gate 2 grid connection in NESO's Existing Agreements Register as relayed by APRS (page updated July 2026). PlanIt search of Glasgow City 'data centre' records 2019-2026 found no Easterhouse-area record (only small unit conversions elsewhere in the city); no developer or press attribution found.

latest_development.headline: APRS data centre map (updated 29 July 2026) lists Easterhouse 500MW among five gate 2 connection sites 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'

unknowns: The NESO register row (connectee, connection site, dates) has not been independently extracted; the 500MW figure rests on APRS's reading.

Exact location: 'Easterhouse' could denote the housing area, the adjacent Easterfield/Gartloch fringe, or the SPEN Easterhouse 275kV substation area — a substation-named connection need not mean a development within Easterhouse itself.

No developer or connectee identified. The commissioning brief suggested Apatura as a presumption, but no located source attributes Easterhouse to Apatura or anyone else (a June 2025 'Apatura plans 500MW campus' DCD story concerns Drumshangie/Ravenscraig contexts, not Easterhouse).
Whether the end use is a data centre rather than another demand user or storage.
No planning activity of any kind was found.
Local authority could be North Lanarkshire if the site sits east of the boundary near the Easterhouse substation.
